title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
主要内容: On September 21, 2016, the Federal Reserve issued a FOMC statement emphasizing continued labor market strength and increased economic activity. The unemployment rate remained stable, with solid job gains. Household spending grew strongly, while business fixed investment remained soft. Inflation stayed below the 2% target, influenced by energy price declines and non-energy import price drops. Market-based inflation compensation remained low, and survey-based inflation expectations showed little change. The Fed decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 1/4 to 1/2 percent. The Committee expects moderate economic growth and further labor market strengthening. Inflation is projected to rise to 2% over the medium term. Monetary policy remains accommodative, supporting labor market improvement and a return to 2% inflation. The Committee will assess economic conditions relative to its objectives of maximum employment and 2% inflation.
